description: Source code for a Flask-based appointment booking system, including functions for retrieving settings, available slots, creating appointments, and timezone conversions.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Retrieves context if scheduling is enabled, otherwise redirects with a message.

methods.name: get_appointment_settings
methods.description: Fetches appointment booking settings and associated holiday list.

methods.name: get_timezones
methods.description: Returns list of all available timezones.

methods.name: get_appointment_slots
methods.description: Calculates available appointment slots for a given date and timezone.

methods.name: get_available_slots_between
methods.description: Generates available time slots between start and end times based on settings.

methods.name: create_appointment
methods.description: Creates a new appointment document with provided date, time, timezone, and contact info.

methods.name: filter_timeslots
methods.description: Filters timeslots to include only those matching a specific date.

methods.name: convert_to_guest_timezone
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to the guest's timezone.

methods.name: convert_to_system_timezone
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to the system's timezone.

methods.name: check_availabilty
methods.description: Checks if a timeslot is available based on existing appointments and number of agents.

methods.name: _is_holiday
methods.description: Determines if a date is a holiday based on the holiday list.

methods.name: _get_records
methods.description: Retrieves availability records matching the weekday of start or end time.

methods.name: _deltatime_to_datetime
methods.description: Converts a timedelta to a datetime on a specific date.

methods.name: _datetime_to_deltatime
methods.description: Converts a datetime to a timedelta from midnight.
